description: Deterministic synchronization receipt emitted to stdout and optionally to ignored/private runtime storage. Synchronization success is dimensioned: identity, content, structure, and presentation are verified according to task intent.
sanitized_tracking_rules: Tracked/public projections remove provider_revision, provider_change_token, local_scratch_path, raw baseline-store location, and raw locator/account identity.
Provider/baseline fingerprints are retained only when one-way and unusable as locators.
SYNCED requires every required fidelity dimension to appear in verified_fidelity_dimensions.
A format action requires presentation in required_fidelity_dimensions and cannot report SYNCED until presentation is verified on the authoritative target.
A provider-bound push/reconcile mutation must not report SYNCED until provider_write_performed=true and provider read-back verification succeeds.
A pull may report SYNCED without a provider write after provider freshness/read and the required local fidelity dimensions are verified.
A local derivative that contains the requested formatting while the authoritative provider source remains visually unchanged is not a synchronized result.
The durable baseline advances only after the operation's required fidelity verification succeeds; blocked/failed operations do not advance it.
A blocked or failed sync does not disable future checkpoint or periodic attempts.
